item.title: Trump proven right on Iran's long-range missile capability as regime targets US-UK base, experts say
item.summary: Experts say Iran's Diego Garcia missile launch exposes alleged deception about range limits, with analysts warning Europe now faces a direct ballistic threat.

item.title: FDNY turns to March Madness to deliver warning on illegal hydrant parking in New York
item.summary: As March Madness excitement builds, the FDNY reminded New Yorkers not to park illegally at fire hydrants. Cars parked too close to a hydrant can cause critical delays.

item.title: Florida woman seen on video allegedly attacking pregnant driver, elderly bystander and biting police officer
item.summary: An Orlando woman is accused of punching a pregnant woman during a road rage dispute near the Mall of Millenia, then allegedly biting a police officer.

item.title: MLB umpire caught on hot mic begging pitch to 'please be a strike' after catcher issues ABS challenge
item.summary: MLB's Automated Ball-Strike System had a memorable spring training moment when umpire Bill Miller's open mic caught him saying, "Please be a strike" during a challenge.

item.title: Top 5 states with the highest number of safest hospitals, according to new report
item.summary: Healthgrades named 438 hospitals across 40 states for its 2026 Patient Safety Excellence Award, with Texas and Florida among the top-performing states.

item.title: Kurt Russell and Goldie Hawn never married, deciding 43 years ago to 'have fun until we don't'
item.summary: Kurt Russell and Goldie Hawn have sustained their remarkable 43-year relationship with one guiding motto: "Let's have fun until we don't," he reveals.

item.title: Never-before-seen photos of Neil Armstrong's near-fatal NASA mission surface 60 years later
item.summary: Neil Armstrong photos from NASA's 1966 Gemini 8 emergency splashdown near Japan are now public, donated to the Armstrong Air and Space Museum in Wapakoneta, Ohio.

item.title: Tiger Woods eyes Masters comeback, admits lingering back problems bring good and bad days
item.summary: Tiger Woods says disc replacement is "not a lot of fun" as he recovers from a seventh back procedure and has not ruled out playing in the upcoming Masters.

item.title: Villanova coach turns heads after 'joke' that he would 'fire my staff' during March Madness loss
item.summary: Kevin Willard claimed his staff-firing comments were a joke after getting backlash, but critics on social media said the Wildcats coach showed no accountability.

item.title: Trump administration urges judge to dissolve injunction blocking Abrego Garcia's deportation to Liberia
item.summary: The DOJ urged a judge to dissolve an injunction blocking Kilmar Abrego Garcia's re-detention, claiming the court's own order is the sole impediment to his deportation to Liberia.
